articles.title: Global Market: European shares rally as healthcare gains offset eurozone fiscal concerns
articles.content: European shares climbed to near one-week highs, led by healthcare stocks, while easing eurozone bond yields offered some relief. Investors remained focused on fiscal pressures, political uncertainty and upcoming economic data for clues on the region’s outlook.

articles.title: LIC mints Rs 531 crore in one day as Trent shares rally 13%; insurance behemoth’s stake value nears Rs 4,700 cr

articles.title: Global Market:  Gulf oil flows rebound to 81% of pre-war levels in September
articles.content: Gulf oil flows excluding Iran recovered to 81% of pre-war levels in September, supported by a sharp rebound in Saudi Arabian exports. Crude and condensate shipments reached 91% of pre-war levels, while refined fuel exports remained weaker. Volatile daily flows, however, raise questions over the sustainability of the recovery.

articles.title: Indian banks face a Q2 paradox: FCNR boosts loan growth but margins shrink
articles.content: Indian banks are heading into the Q2 earnings season with strong loan growth, helped by FCNR(B) deposit inflows, but margins are likely to remain under pressure. Analysts expect healthy earnings growth on lower credit costs and stable asset quality, while favouring large private banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.

articles.title: Global Market:  BOJ seen nearing 2% inflation target as markets eye December rate hike
articles.content: The Bank of Japan may signal later this month that underlying inflation has reached its 2% target, strengthening expectations for a December rate hike. While policymakers remain cautious after recent increases, steady wages, rising prices and yen weakness could support further tightening as the BOJ gradually normalises monetary policy.

articles.title: Why junk bonds deliver equity-like returns but with far inferior volatility, explains Saurabh Mukherjea
articles.content: High-yield bonds, often labelled “junk”, have historically delivered a large share of stock market returns with lower volatility. Saurabh Mukherjea explains how coupons, seniority in repayment and diversification can make them useful in portfolios.

articles.title: Banks vs NBFCs: Which stocks could benefit as RBI eyes rate hike for first time in 3 years?
articles.content: The RBI’s expected first rate hike in three years could have a mixed impact on banks and NBFCs. While higher funding costs may pressure NBFC margins, lenders with floating-rate assets and strong liquidity could benefit. Brokerages favour HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance and Tata Capital.

articles.title: Global Market: Euro under pressure as France debt worries, Spain vote weigh
articles.content: The euro hovered near a 17-month low at $1.1219 amid euro zone political uncertainty, high debt and French fiscal concerns. Meanwhile, the dollar strengthened as US Treasury yields climbed, with persistent inflation limiting expectations for monetary easing. Markets also monitored potential Bank of Japan tightening as the yen remained weak against the dollar.

articles.title: Rupee slips to over 2-month low on portfolio outflows, RBI likely steps in
articles.content: The Indian rupee faced a setback on Tuesday, falling to its weakest position in more than two months. Continuous foreign divestment in local assets heightened pressure on the currency, igniting discussions of possible intervention from the central bank. Analysts foresee a cautious depreciation of the rupee throughout the upcoming year, bolstered by positive capital inflows into foreign reserves.

articles.title: AWL Agri Business shares climb 4% as Q2 revenue rises 24% YoY,  Food & FMCG posts record quarterly revenue
articles.content: AWL Agri Business shares rose nearly 4% after Q2 revenue grew 24% year-on-year, driven by strong performance in Food & FMCG and Industry Essentials.
